author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 19; ensure at least four current turns classified as product_technical across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smart thermostat and is having trouble with the companion app.

messages.content: I got the thermostat yesterday and installed it, but the app keeps saying 'device offline'.
Sorry about that. Could you confirm the thermostat's display shows a solid green light?
Yes, it's solid green. The Wi-Fi in my house is fine too.
Thanks. Try deleting the device from the app and re-adding it using the QR code on the back panel.

variants.text: I did that and it still won't connect. Is there a firmware update I should install first?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just return this and get a different brand.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Wait, before I try that — does this model support 5GHz networks or only 2.4GHz?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but received a floor lamp instead.

messages.content: My package arrived but it's the wrong item — I ordered the Arlo floor lamp, not the desk version.
I'm sorry for the mix-up. Would you like a replacement or a refund for the incorrect item?
I'd like a replacement, but I'm leaving town next week for a month.
Understood. I can hold the replacement shipment until you're back if you prefer.

variants.text: That works. Please ship it after the 15th when I'm home again.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just refund me instead. I'll buy it locally.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hold on — is the replacement going to be the floor lamp I ordered, or could it also be wrong? How do you verify stock before shipping?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a coffee grinder's burr material before purchasing.

messages.content: I'm comparing your burr grinder with another brand. What kind of burrs does yours use?
Ours uses flat stainless steel burrs, 38mm in diameter.
And are those replaceable if they wear out over time?
Yes, replacement burr sets are sold separately on our site for about $25.

variants.text: Great, that settles it. I'll take the grinder — can you add the spare burr set to the same order?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, actually I read that conical burrs give a more consistent grind. Do you have a model with those?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks for the info. By the way, is there a way to talk to a real person about which grinder suits espresso best?
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer's subscription order for pet food was charged twice this month.

messages.content: I was charged twice for my monthly cat food subscription — two separate $42 charges.
I see that. One charge was from the 3rd and another from the 8th. Let me check if a duplicate order was created.
It looks like there are two shipments scheduled too. I only want one bag per month.
You're right — a system glitch duplicated your subscription. I'll cancel the second one and refund the extra charge.

variants.text: Perfect, please do that. And make sure my next month's delivery isn't affected by this mess.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, while you're at it — can you switch my subscription to the 12kg bag instead of the 7kg one?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait, before you cancel anything — will the refund go back to my original card or as store credit?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer cannot log into their account after changing email address.

messages.content: I changed my email on my account yesterday and now I can't log in at all.
Let me look into that. Did you receive a verification link at the new email address?
I got the link and clicked it, but the login page still says my password is wrong.
That's odd. Let me reset your password and send a temporary one to your new email.

variants.text: Okay, I'll wait for that email. Thanks for the quick help.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, you know what, I think I might have two accounts from years ago. Could that be causing the confusion?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Before that — I also want to check on my order from last week. It said delivered but I never got it.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer bought a waterproof Bluetooth speaker and is asking about outdoor use.

messages.content: I just got the WaveRider speaker. How deep can it actually go underwater?
It's rated IP67, so it can be submerged up to 1 meter for 30 minutes.
I want to use it while kayaking — it might get splashed a lot but not fully submerged.
Splashes are totally fine. Just make sure the rubber flap over the USB port is sealed shut.

variants.text: Good to know. One more thing — does the speaker float if it falls in the water?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Perfect, that's all I needed. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I'm worried about the kayak trip damaging it. What's your return policy if it stops working after getting wet?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a standing desk's height range for their tall frame.

messages.content: I'm 6'5" and I'm worried the standing desk won't go high enough for me.
The ErgoLift desk adjusts from 62cm to 127cm, which should accommodate most tall users.
Hmm, 127cm seems a bit low. My current desk is 130cm and it's barely comfortable.
I understand. We do sell a riser attachment that adds 8cm to the maximum height.

variants.text: Oh, that riser sounds perfect. Does it affect the desk's stability when typing at full height?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Great, I'll order the desk with the riser. Can you combine shipping on both items?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I just realized I should check if my office chair can even go high enough to match. Never mind for now.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and is upset about the packaging.

messages.content: The vase arrived cracked in three places. The box looked fine but the foam inside was way too thin.
I'm really sorry to hear that. I'll file a damage claim and send you a replacement right away.
I don't want another one if it's going to arrive broken the same way.
That's fair. We've since upgraded to thicker molded foam for all ceramic items.

variants.text: Okay, I'll give it another shot. But if this one arrives damaged too, I want a full refund and I'm filing a complaint.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Alright, send the replacement. Also, can you make sure the delivery driver doesn't leave it at the door this time?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I appreciate that, but honestly I'd rather speak to a supervisor about how this was packed in the first place.
variants.label: human_service
